sql: SELECT callee_name, COUNT(*) AS sites, COUNT(DISTINCT file) AS files FROM calls WHERE callee_name IN ('boot','boot_timer','options','font_ctx') AND callee_kind = 'fn' AND callee_file LIKE '%seven_guis/src/stand.rs' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT from_crate, to_crate FROM crate_edges WHERE to_crate IN ('seven_guis','blitz-test-harness','escher-telemetry') OR from_crate IN ('seven_guis','blitz-test-harness','escher-telemetry') ORDER BY 1, 2
SELECT name, crate, kind, file FROM symbol WHERE (lower(name) LIKE '%session%' OR lower(name) LIKE 'driver%' OR lower(name) LIKE 'escher_driver%') AND kind <> 'meta' ORDER BY crate, name
